prompt: Who was older, the guitar player for the Dugites from 1982-1983 or the lead singer of The Sports?
answer: Andrew Pendlebury, the Dugites’ guitarist from 1982–1983, was older. He was born in 1952, while The Sports’ lead singer Stephen Cummings was born in 1954—about two years younger.
